tools.name: read_worksheet_info
tools.title: Read worksheet info
tools.description: Inspect worksheets in the workbook: names, indices, visibility state, used range dimensions, tables, and charts. Read-only. [Registry tool v1, Workbook, transaction=none. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Excel — prefer them over execute_excel_code for the same task.]

sheet.description: Specific sheet name to inspect. If omitted, inspects all sheets in workbook.

workbook.description: Workbook name or file path. Defaults to active workbook.

tools.name: get_run
tools.title: Get a past run
tools.description: Details of one run from the history (runId comes back from the execute tool, run_tool and test_tool): outcome, args, the code when it was a successful ad-hoc script, and — when the host application is reachable — an analysis listing hard-coded literals (line, value, variable) and the args keys already read. Use it before propose_tool to decide which literals become parameters.

analyze.description: Analyse the code (guard, compile, literals) through the host application

tools.name: format_range
tools.title: Format range
tools.description: Apply formatting to a range: number format, font styling (bold, size, color), fill background color (hex), borders, and alignment. Takes an automatic snapshot before writing. [Registry tool v1, Format, transaction=auto. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Excel — prefer them over execute_excel_code for the same task.]

sheet.description: Worksheet name. Defaults to active sheet.

workbook.description: Workbook name or file path. Defaults to active workbook.

dryRun.description: Run the tool, then roll everything back. Use first on a model you care about.

tools.name: evaluate_formula
tools.title: Evaluate formula
tools.description: Evaluate an Excel formula expression dynamically in the context of the active worksheet or workbook. Returns evaluated value and data type. Read-only. [Registry tool v1, Calculation, transaction=none. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Excel — prefer them over execute_excel_code for the same task.]

formula.description: Excel formula string (e.g. 'SUM(A1:A10)', 'VLOOKUP("Rebar", B1:F20, 3, FALSE)'). Leading '=' optional.

sheet.description: Context worksheet. Defaults to active sheet.

workbook.description: Workbook name or file path. Defaults to active workbook.

tools.name: cancel_execution
tools.title: Cancel running script
tools.description: Signals cancellation to the script currently running in the host application. Cancellation is cooperative: the script stops at its next `ct` check, and its transaction group is rolled back. Returns whether anything was running.

tools.name: read_range
tools.title: Read range
tools.description: Read cell values, formulas, or formatted text from a worksheet range (e.g. 'A1:D10') or named range into JSON. Supports fast batch array reads. Read-only. [Registry tool v1, Data, transaction=none. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Excel — prefer them over execute_excel_code for the same task.]

range.description: Cell range address (e.g. 'A1:C10', 'Sheet2!B5:E20') or named range. If omitted, reads the worksheet's used range.

sheet.description: Worksheet name. Defaults to active worksheet.

workbook.description: Workbook name or file path. Defaults to active workbook.

outputFormat.description: Output representation: 'values' (raw values), 'formulas' (formulas if present), 'formatted' (display text).

hasHeaders.description: If true, treats the first row as headers and returns an array of JSON objects.

maxRows.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

tools.name: execute_excel_code
tools.title: Execute C# in Excel
tools.description: Runs a C# script against the Microsoft Excel session attached to the HPExcel MCP Bridge. Globals: excel (Excel.Application), workbook (active Workbook), sheet (active Worksheet), ct, log(string), progress(cur,total,msg), args (args.Str/Int/Double/Bool(key, fallback)). ClosedXML.Excel is available for headless .xlsx manipulation. End with `return <value>;`. Three tiers: R read-only (read_range, read_worksheet_info, find_cells, read_table, evaluate_formula; transaction=none). W write (write_range, format_range, create_table, create_chart, export_worksheet; transaction=auto; automatic .xlsx snapshot saved before writing). D destructive (delete worksheet, clear contents, run_macro; requires 'Allow destructive operations' toggle in bridge UI; automatic snapshot saved before execution; timeout up to 600s). dryRun on a writing script provides a static preview without execution. Never call Application.Quit, Process.Start, or modal dialogs (blocked by guard). Requires 'Allow AI code execution' enabled in the HPExcel MCP Bridge desktop window.

code.description: C# script body, max 32 KB. No `await`, no System.IO / System.Net / reflection / interop, no Quit/dialog calls (blocked by guard).

transaction.description: auto (default): writing script — takes an automatic .xlsx backup snapshot before running. none: read-only script. manual: accepted for compatibility, behaves like auto.

dryRun.description: Static preview for a writing script; a read-only script runs normally. Refused for destructive members.

timeoutSeconds.description: Cooperative timeout in seconds, 5–120 (up to 600 while destructive operations are allowed).

label.description: Short name for the audit log and snapshot file name. Max 64 characters; letters, digits, _ and - survive, the rest becomes _.

args.description: Optional JSON object handed to the script as `args` (e.g. {"range": "A1:D10", "sheet": "Sheet1"}). Keys are matched case-insensitively.

tools.name: write_range
tools.title: Write range
tools.description: Batch write 2D values, arrays, or formulas to a range starting at target cell. Auto-sizes destination range. Takes an automatic snapshot before writing. [Registry tool v1, Data, transaction=auto. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Excel — prefer them over execute_excel_code for the same task.]

values.description: 2D array of rows and columns to write: [[row1_col1, row1_col2], [row2_col1, row2_col2]].

sheet.description: Target worksheet. Defaults to active sheet.

workbook.description: Workbook name or file path. Defaults to active workbook.

isFormula.description: If true, treats string values starting with '=' as active formulas.

dryRun.description: Run the tool, then roll everything back. Use first on a model you care about.

tools.name: run_macro
tools.title: Run macro
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE: Execute an existing VBA macro / Sub procedure in the active workbook with optional arguments. Requires explicit Destructive toggle enabled in Bridge UI. Takes an automatic snapshot before running. [Registry tool v1, Automation, transaction=auto. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Excel — prefer them over execute_excel_code for the same task.]

macroName.description: Name of the VBA macro to execute (e.g. 'RefreshAllData', 'Module1.ProcessSchedule').

args.description: Optional parameters to pass to the macro.

workbook.description: Workbook name or file path containing the macro. Defaults to active workbook.

dryRun.description: Run the tool, then roll everything back. Use first on a model you care about.

tools.name: run_tool
tools.title: Run a registry tool
tools.description: Run a stored tool from the registry with the given args (must match its inputSchema from search_tools / get_tool). Same result shape as the execute tool. Draft / tested / pending tools need allowUnpublished=true. Use dryRun=true first for tools that modify the document.

allowUnpublished.description: Allow running a tool that is not published yet

tools.name: export_worksheet
tools.title: Export worksheet
tools.description: Export a worksheet or entire workbook to PDF or CSV format on disk. Returns generated file path and size. Takes an automatic snapshot before export. [Registry tool v1, Export, transaction=auto. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Excel — prefer them over execute_excel_code for the same task.]

outputPath.description: Target destination file path. If omitted, exports beside the workbook.

sheet.description: Worksheet to export. Required for CSV; optional for PDF (exports full workbook if omitted).

workbook.description: Workbook name or file path. Defaults to active workbook.

fitToPage.description: Fit content to 1 page wide (PDF only).

dryRun.description: Run the tool, then roll everything back. Use first on a model you care about.

tools.name: read_table
tools.title: Read table
tools.description: Read structured Excel table (ListObject) headers, data rows as JSON records, and totals row. Read-only. [Registry tool v1, Data, transaction=none. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Excel — prefer them over execute_excel_code for the same task.]

sheet.description: Worksheet containing the table. If omitted, searches all worksheets.

workbook.description: Workbook name or file path. Defaults to active workbook.

maxRows.description: Maximum number of data rows to return.

tools.name: get_excel_context
tools.title: Get Excel context
tools.description: Returns the Microsoft Excel session the bridge app is attached to: hostVersion (2026), docTitle and docPath of active workbook, isModifiable (workbook is open, Excel is idle — no modal dialog active), executionEnabled, destructiveOperationsEnabled, active sheet name, used range, selected cells/range, worksheet count, and open workbook count. Call this before execute_excel_code to understand the workbook layout and active sheet.

includeSelection.description: Include the currently selected range or cells in Excel.

tools.name: propose_tool
tools.title: Propose a new registry tool
tools.description: Package a working C# script as a reusable tool (status draft). Replace every literal that may change between calls with args.<Kind>("key") and declare each key in inputSchema (JSON Schema object: string/number/integer/boolean/array/object, required, default, description). The code is guard-checked and compiled inside the host application but not run. Give ≥ 2 examples with different args; test_tool runs them. Returns a validation report; fix errors and call again. Use newVersion=true to replace the code of an existing tool.

description.description: What the tool does, for search and for the reviewer (≥ 20 chars)

category.description: One of the host's categories (search_tools lists them): Architecture | Structure | MEP | Annotation | View | Data | Generic for Revit, Drawing | Layer | Block | Annotation | Layout | Data | Generic for AutoCAD

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema of the args object

code.description: Script body: same globals as the execute tool plus args; must end with return

title.description: Human title, e.g. 'Colour beams by type'

transaction.description: auto (the bridge wraps the run in a transaction) | manual (Revit: the code opens its own Transaction; AutoCAD: same as auto) | none (read-only)

sourceRunId.description: runId of the execute run this comes from (see get_run)

newVersion.description: Propose a new version of an existing tool name

tools.name: publish_tool
tools.title: Publish a registry tool
tools.description: Request publication of a tested tool. Policy manual (default): the tool becomes pending_approval, a review file is written and a human must run the server's `registry approve <name>` command (`<server>.exe registry --help`; or set status=published in tool.json). Policy auto: tested tools publish immediately. Published tools appear in tools/list of every running server.

tools.name: create_table
tools.title: Create table
tools.description: Convert a range of cells into a structured Excel Table (ListObject) with headers, applied styling, and optional totals row. Takes an automatic snapshot before writing. [Registry tool v1, Data, transaction=auto. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Excel — prefer them over execute_excel_code for the same task.]

range.description: Cell range to convert to table (e.g. 'A1:E50').

sheet.description: Worksheet name. Defaults to active sheet.

workbook.description: Workbook name or file path. Defaults to active workbook.

showTotalsRow.description: Whether to display the table totals row.

dryRun.description: Run the tool, then roll everything back. Use first on a model you care about.

tools.name: create_chart
tools.title: Create chart
tools.description: Create an embedded chart (Column, Line, Pie, Bar, Area, Scatter) linked to a data range. Custom title, size, and location. Takes an automatic snapshot before writing. [Registry tool v1, Chart, transaction=auto. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Excel — prefer them over execute_excel_code for the same task.]

dataRange.description: Cell range containing chart source data (e.g. 'A1:D10').

sheet.description: Worksheet name. Defaults to active sheet.

workbook.description: Workbook name or file path. Defaults to active workbook.

targetCell.description: Top-left cell where the chart should be placed.

dryRun.description: Run the tool, then roll everything back. Use first on a model you care about.

tools.name: inspect_type
tools.title: Inspect a host API type
tools.description: Reflects over an API type loaded in the running host application (Revit or AutoCAD) and returns its public members as C#-like signatures (kind: property | method | field | event). Use it to confirm exact method names and parameters before writing a script.

typeName.description: Type name, e.g. 'Wall' or 'FilteredElementCollector' in Revit, 'Polyline' or 'LayerTableRecord' in AutoCAD, or a fully qualified name such as 'Autodesk.Revit.DB.Structure.Rebar'.

memberFilter.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to keep only matching member names, e.g. 'Create'.

maxMembers.description: Maximum number of members to return (default 100, max 500).

tools.name: manage_worksheet
tools.title: Manage worksheet
tools.description: Manage workbook sheets: add, rename, duplicate, delete, or change visibility (visible, hidden, very_hidden). Deleting a sheet is DESTRUCTIVE. Takes an automatic snapshot before execution. [Registry tool v1, Workbook, transaction=auto. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Excel — prefer them over execute_excel_code for the same task.]

newSheetName.description: New sheet name (required for 'rename' and optional for 'add'/'duplicate').

workbook.description: Workbook name or file path. Defaults to active workbook.

dryRun.description: Run the tool, then roll everything back. Use first on a model you care about.

tools.name: test_tool
tools.title: Test a registry tool
tools.description: Run a tool's examples (or the given cases) inside the host application with dryRun — every change is rolled back — and record the outcomes. All cases passing moves a draft to tested. realRun=true commits the changes (only on a scratch model).

cases.description: Optional cases [{"title": "...", "args": {...}}]; default = the tool's examples

tools.name: manage_tool
tools.title: Deprecate, quarantine or restore a tool
tools.description: deprecate: retire a tool (never runs again until restored). quarantine: pull it from tools/list. restore: back to draft so it can be tested and published again.

annotations.title: Deprecate, quarantine or restore a tool

tools.name: get_tool
tools.title: Get a registry tool
tools.description: Full record of one stored tool: metadata, input schema, examples, C# code (optional), run statistics and recent runs.

recentRuns.description: How many recent runs to include (0–50)

tools.name: find_cells
tools.title: Find cells
tools.description: Search for matching text, numbers, or formula patterns across a worksheet or entire workbook. Returns matched cell addresses and values. Read-only. [Registry tool v1, Data, transaction=none. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Excel — prefer them over execute_excel_code for the same task.]

query.description: Text or value to search for.

sheet.description: Worksheet name to search. Defaults to active sheet.

workbook.description: Workbook name or file path. Defaults to active workbook.

lookIn.description: Look in cell values or formulas.

exactMatch.description: Match entire cell contents vs substring.

searchAllSheets.description: If true, searches across all worksheets in the workbook.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of matched cells to return.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.title: Search the tool registry
tools.description: Search the registry of stored tools for this host (Revit or AutoCAD) BEFORE writing code with the execute tool (execute_revit_code / execute_autocad_code). Full-text over name, description, tags and examples, ranked by relevance × stability × status. Returns each tool's inputSchema so it can be called directly by name (published tools are real MCP tools) or through run_tool. Empty query lists tools (optionally by category).

query.description: What you want to do, in any language, e.g. 'tạo lưới trục', 'color beams by type', 'room schedule'

category.description: One of the host's categories (search_tools lists them): Architecture | Structure | MEP | Annotation | View | Data | Generic for Revit, Drawing | Layer | Block | Annotation | Layout | Data | Generic for AutoCAD

includeUnpublished.description: Also return draft / tested / pending tools (they need allowUnpublished=true in run_tool)
